title: 5 PROBLEMS IN SUV CARS. THINK AGAIN !!
description: Here are 5 Problems in Compact SUV and Mid SUV Cars in India. Think again before buying SUV car like Renault Kiger, Nissan Magnite or other SUV Cars in segment

asr.full_text: Welcome to My Car Helpline! How are you? The topic today is... How can my dream dream be shattered? How can dream dream break with me? So please listen to what I have to say carefully... As I am already sending this statement to you. There is an English saying that... Everyone has their own requirements and preferences. But the Indian passenger brand has become a bad dress preference but the Indian passenger market is moving towards the SUV class. It is not a bad thing that the mattress is in the style of a Bheer-chaal . And one thing that has happened in Indian today, the show-off trend is SUVs, so everyone needs an SUV even if they don't need an SUV. you just because they are being called SUV cars for the sake of high ground clearance other Magnite or Kiger up up kick contention list may to sahab please experience Tata Altroz but miss all of the head because they were also pretty shocked here Altroz to hatchback and Magnite and Kiger they are are SUVs. What a comparison! For what sake are you buying your next new car? This is a question I need to ask to you and I ask them also. Have you driven Tata Altros? Have you experienced the handling dynamics of the car? Have you experienced the steering feedback of the car? What is the maneuverability? What is the body roll? What is the maneuverability and body roll? as well as how is the highway dynamics? What is its experience in terms of build quality? Yes, the Cijger and Magnite are spacious, but how can you consider a space like Altrose with respect to its exterior? Magnite and Cijker are appealing according to their looks, whereas Altrose is more in its looks but Altroz's style element is unique For what are you buying your next new car? For the sake of this much ground clearance you almost have 40 mm which is almost from 1 to a half inch you should be buying the Magnitek If you like superior driving dynamics and better travelability For the sake of better build quality better built quality, more premium styling... If you are into manual transmissions, i have strong information for you guys, if you don't have many major potholes under you to deal with, In my opinion, increase your budget and buy an SUV. But if major bads don't exist then please experience Tata Altross, to the best of my view it can outperform the so-called SUVs let me be blunt and clear with you in that perspective. Number 2 Now see, among Indians absolutely when we purchase a car later, in the heart of us Indians, We can't help but think, what would be the price of the vehicle? You guys must be knowing the prices of petrol in India, it is almost in the range of Rs. 90 per litre. Fuel efficiency in a car, is a very important element in the manufacturing process. You can guess that, you will only find 100 Raja Pa passing in Delhi, Mumbai in 2021 If cars running costs are about 7 to 8 rupees and you are shocked as people are increasing their expenses SUV cars tend to offer you lesser mileage as against the hatch back segment as against the sedan segment and the reason for this is SUV cars have wider tyres. They have higher ground clearance. And somehow, some SUV cars are having higher curb body weight. If you see on the screen are the most fuel-efficient SUV cars. In comparison, in terms of hatchback cars comparative hatchback, comparative with Sedan cars tend to offer you better efficiency as compared to SUV cars So, you can assume that the running cost of your car will be bigger Number three, ground clearance and because of this, SUV cars are selling out of demand Sir, there's one term in which is called as Center of gravity in Physics. If you are into cars then you probably know that there is less ground clearance in cars in Europe and the USA. When the cars haven't been ground- cleared, the center of gravity is on the lower side. Those cars offer you better handling. The body roll of cars is also less. Car's manoeuvrability and handling dynamics are impressive. I'm going to present this as a press conference too. There are some countries where SUV cars are being been used by elderly folks and cars like Sedan, Hatchback, having lower ground clearance or sports cars are used by young people but in India Young people need SUV cars Drive your car and you'll see the dynamics of the car Have you driven Hyundai Creta? It has soft suspension. You get a flush ride, but the car you get body roll. And driven Honda cars in India City, driven Hyundai Verna even, driven Vantos, Ford RAPID. Trust me, you get a notch above the handling the handling of a sedan. So remember all these points and try it for yourself, what exactly is your need. That is a very important parameter. Number four. From today, trend of people wanting SUV. Is this your family size? SUV having better space management, even Skoda's Koshyak is going to come with better space management but if you have family requirements in the rear then test drive in Honda Cars India's city test drive in Maruti Suzuki Ciaz you will get an amazing cabin space and that space becomes an important element and number 5 last but not the least, trust me this point will be a deal breaker for you. What do you know about SUVs? The SUV cars that are coming in the market, the so called SUV cars, the Indian passenger car manufacturers have changed the definition of SUVs. Earlier the SUV used to have a powerful engine. Now what is happening is that 1200cc engine which has 83 PS power this 1.0-litre 3-cylinder petrol engine with just 70-75 PS power the companies are even calling them SUV cars for the sake of high ground clearance. Earlier the road presence of the car, suspension dynamics, handling of the car used cars were quite impressive for SUV cars. SUV used to be SUV, sports utility vehicle, those cars had an off road dynamics. People felt they could easily drive a car in a jungle or a bad road. There was all-wheel drive in cars and rear-wheel drive cars. But today, in the name of SUVs, the so-called cars are being sold by the Indian consumers. Sorry, Tussin. But this is what a reality.
